stories.title: No. 4 Texas mounts late rally, shocks No. 1 Ohio State
stories.summary: Arch Manning helped Texas overcome a 23-3 fourth-quarter deficit, leading scoring drives of 15, 13 and 12 plays as the Longhorns stunned No. 1 Ohio State 24-23 on Saturday.

stories.title: 'This one hurts': Day's Buckeyes fold in fourth quarter
stories.summary: The No. 1 Ohio State Buckeyes controlled the game for more than three quarters, but quickly unraveled in the fourth, dropping a 24-23 decision to No. 4 Texas on Saturday night, with coach Ryan Day telling reporters afterward that "this one hurts."

stories.title: Oklahoma State stuns No. 6 Oregon, ending 21-game FBS skid
stories.summary: Oklahoma State ended a 21-game skid against FBS opponents by pulling off the first true stunner of the 2026 season, beating No. 6 Oregon 39-31 on Saturday.

stories.title: Rybakina defeats Sabalenka, wins first US Open title
stories.summary: Elena Rybakina won her first US Open championship and punctuated her climb to the top of women's tennis by defeating Aryna Sabalenka 6-4, 5-7, 6-2 Saturday at Arthur Ashe Stadium in New York, the third Grand Slam title of her career and second this year.

stories.title: Garcia backs up talk, TKO's Benn in second round to retain WBC title
stories.summary: Ryan Garcia needed only two rounds to take out Conor Benn on Saturday night, recording his fastest knockout in six years to retain his WBC welterweight championship.
